strings.name: Denzel Washington
strings.summary: After Fordham and professional acting training, Washington moved from theatre and television into film. Glory, Malcolm X and Training Day feature soldiers, historical figures and morally conflicted characters, earning him two acting Oscars. His stage performance and film direction of Fences extend August Wilson’s reach; directing and production also contribute to Black history and family narratives.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Performances in Malcolm X and Training Day, together with production work, influence Black historical narratives and American film culture.

strings.highlights.h2.title: Stage and production

strings.timeline.t1.title: Honorary Palme d’Or

strings.timeline.t2.title: Directed Fences

strings.timeline.t3.title: Tony Award
